plan.rationale: This operation explicitly parses category mappings to left, middle, and right baskets and performs visually grounded grasp-and-place. RGB shows three open baskets and pepper, watch, and wooden toy objects, matching the requested placement geometry. Bind pepper to left, watch to middle, and wooden_toy to right. Its observation-batch input and end-effector action-chunk output fit the configured library contracts. Unlike visual-attribute-placement, it preserves language-specified destinations rather than assigning baskets by transfer cost. Resetting the arm afterward is a shared lifecycle action.
